articles.title: Champions League draw: Arsenal face Real Madrid, Man City get Barcelona and PSG
articles.summary: Manchester United will host Bayern Munich. Aston Villa welcome PSG; Liverpool go to Inter. Arsenal face mouthwatering assignments against Real Madrid and Bayern Munich as they bid to go one better than last season’s agonising near miss and win a first Champions League title.
body: Mikel Arteta’s side were pipped on penalties by Paris Saint-Germain in the final three months ago and will be expected to cruise through this season’s league phase. The bulk of their draw appears kind but they are tasked with a visit to the Allianz Arena to play Bayern, who they beat 3-1 at the Emirates Stadium last November, and host Real, who are once again under the charge of José Mourinho. Two seasons ago, Arsenal beat the Spanish giants 3-0 at home in a quarter-final first leg, Declan Rice scoring two memorable free-kicks.

Arsenal will also welcome Borussia Dortmund, Lille and the Azerbaijani debutants Sabah to north London. Their other away fixtures involve trips to Napoli, Slavia Prague and a reunion with their ex-player Hector Bellerin at Real Betis.

articles.title: WNBA star Brink launches withering attack on Kanter Freedom over anti-trans stunt
articles.summary: LA star brands stunts as attempts to ‘stay relevant’ Brink defends trans community in face of attacks. Opinion: Kanter is using his freedom to punch down. Los Angeles Sparks star Cameron Brink has called former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom a “stupid piece of shit” who is “trying to stay…
body: Brink, the No 2 overall pick in the 2024 draft, spoke this week to the Mirror about the controversies that have surrounded the league this summer.

After Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham told ESPN last month that transgender women should not be able to participate in women’s sports, the league became a battleground for national debate. The stir arose despite the fact that no player assigned male at birth has ever been on a WNBA roster. The league’s collective bargaining agreement says the WNBA is restricted to women but contains no more specific language about gender identity or sex assigned at birth.

Freedom, an 11-year NBA veteran who last played in 2022, and Royce White, another former NBA player, have publicly declared for the WNBA draft, saying they identify as women. League sources have said the two are not eligible and have framed their actions as publicity stunts.

body: During the interview Khan’s children raised concerns about the Pakistan government’s treatment of the country’s former prime minister, who has been held in solitary confinement for the past three years.

Khan’s lawyers have described his living conditions as slow-motion murder, while his sister has claimed he has been tortured while in prison. The 73-year-old was moved to a hospital last week for treatment after a supreme court ruling permitted his temporary release, but has since been returned to prison.

articles.title: Dario Vidosic to step down as Brighton manager and is leading Angel City candidate
articles.summary: Vidosic’s decision is surprise on eve of WSL season. 39-year-old led Brighton to May’s FA Cup final. The Brighton manager, Dario Vidosic, is to leave the Women’s Super League club a little over a week before the start of the new season, multiple sources have told the Guardian.
body: The Guardian understands Vidosic is the leading candidate for the Angel City head coach role with a view to starting work before the 2027 NWSL season.

Vidosic has been in charge of Brighton for two years and led them to their first Wembley appearance in May’s Women’s FA Cup final. The departure of the 39-year-old Croatia-born Australian, which was first reported by the Daily Telegraph, is understood to have surprised many members of Brighton’s squad.
Brighton, who open their WSL campaign with the visit of Arsenal on 6 September, did not wish to comment on the news when contacted.
Angel City have been led by their interim head coach, Leif Smerud, the former Crystal Palace manager, since June’s departure of Alexander Straus.

articles.title: Smith & Cox help England to 248-9 on truncated day one
articles.summary: Jamie Smith and Jordan Cox battle difficult conditions and an improved Pakistan performance to take England to a competitive total on the opening day of the second Test.
body: In the damp and gloom at Lord's, Smith made 61 and Cox 55 to take England to 248-9 on a first day that was delayed by rain and curtailed by bad light.

The value of the hosts' score will only be revealed in time. The Lord's pitch is much better than the poor surface used for England's win against New Zealand in June, while more rain is forecast for the next three days.

It could be that England have batted themselves into a position from where they can win this match and the series, which would be a successful end to a troubling week dominated by the Brydon Carse controversy.
Cox was again impressive in only his third Test. He added 67 for the for sixth wicket with Smith, who looked fluent for a much-needed half-century.

articles.title: Aldridge & Carse put Durham in control against Glos
articles.summary: Kasey Aldridge's five-wicket haul and two wickets for Brydon Carse put County Championship Division Two leaders Durham in control against Gloucestershire.
body: A Kasey Aldridge five-wicket haul and two wickets for Brydon Carse put County Championship Division Two leaders Durham in control of their fixture with bottom side Gloucestershire.
Carse, who was been omitted from the England Test squad after an incident outside a nightclub, picked up two early wickets to put Durham on top early on.

Aldridge and Matthew Potts backed up Carse's efforts, but James Bracey's half-century provided a glimmer of hope for the visitors. However, Aldridge, who passed 100 First Class wickets while doing it, wrapped up the tail, with Gloucestershire being bowled out for 137.

Durham's reply got off to a difficult start as they found themselves 16-2, but David Bedingham continued his brilliant season with the bat as he smashed a run-a-ball half-century before the day was curtailed by bad light. The hosts will resume on 100-3 on day two, with Gloucestershire leading by 37 runs.

articles.title: Star Seahawks defensive tackle Leonard Williams gets 3-year, $90 million extension
articles.summary: The Seahawks are officially locking down a key member of their defensive line today, Aug. 27, signing defensive tackle Leonard Williams to a three-year, $90 million extension, according to NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport.
body: ESPN’s Adam Schefter also confirms that the extension includes $56 million guaranteed.
Williams is the latest Seahawks player to get an extension, with cornerback Devon Witherspoon signing a 4-year, $132 million extension earlier this month.
32-year-old Williams joined the Seahawks back in 2023, after spending five seasons with both the New York Jets and New York Giants. The Giants traded Williams to Seattle for two draft picks.

Throughout his career, Williams has racked up 61.5 sacks and over 630 total tackles. The Super Bowl champion is also a three-time Pro Bowler, and according to ESPN, one of the highest rated defensive tackles in the NFL.

articles.title: England on back foot as Pakistan's bowlers shine at gloomy Lord's
articles.summary: Mohammad Abbas and Mohammad Ali starred with the ball as Pakistan took advantage of overcast conditions at Lord's to reduce England to 248-9 on day one of the second Test.
body: A deluge of rain had postponed play until 12.20pm on Thursday afternoon, and much like the weather, England's day got off to a dreary start, with the hosts going 3-36 after just 10.3 overs.

After a week dominated by England's latest off-field incident involving bowler Brydon Carse, captain Joe Root's mood would not have lifted much as he was dismissed on Thursday by Abbas for just four runs.
That was further compounded by the cheap dismissals of Ben Duckett (17) and Emilio Gay (8), who were also snared by Abbas.
As the weather improved, England rallied with Jordan Cox bringing up a score of 55 off 105 deliveries and combined well with Jamie Smith, making a partnership of 67 off 97 deliveries.
